headline: Approved February 26, 2026 meeting minutes and heard update on Economic Development Action Plan and Northshore CDC presentation.
summary: The council approved the minutes from its February 26, 2026 meeting. It received an update on the Economic Development Action Plan, noting that the Major Employer Survey is complete and a draft report will be brought to the group within a month. Shantel Alix Fernandez of Northshore CDC presented on the organization's affordable housing, youth development, small business, and community engagement programs, followed by discussion on how the council could support the CDC's work in Beverly.

3. Shantel Alix Fernandez, Director of Community Building, Northshore CDC 35

Shantel Alix Fernandez, Director of Community Building, Northshore CDC, gave a presentation 37 
on the CDC and its goals. Since 2013, the CDC has doubled the amount of affordable housing in 38 
its housing portfolio across the North Shore. The CDC also focuses on youth development, 39 
reengaging at-risk youth in education and getting them ready for workforce management. The 40 
CDC also works on program design for small businesses. The CDC has an incubator space which 41 
is free for anyone who has a business idea, in order to test out their business model for a year. 42 
The CDC also works on community engagement and combines art and economic development. 43 
She noted that the number of incubator applications varies and the CDC is seeking a second 44 
incubator space for restaurant business models.  45
